 <div class="room-info-holder">
 <div class="hotel-info-holder">
 <p class="hotel-title">The Hotel</p>
 <div class="more-about-hotel-holder">
 <p class="hotel-info hotel-info-resize" id="hotel-info">
 Facing the beachfront, Oiti Beach Resort Tutoia offers 4-star accommodation in Tutóia and features an outdoor swimming pool, a fitness center and a garden. The property offers room service and free WiFi throughout. There is a restaurant serving Brazilian cuisine, and free private parking is available (subject to availability). All rooms have a work desk. Rooms at Oiti Beach Resort Tutoia feature a private bathroom with a shower and free toiletries, a flat-screen TV and air conditioning, and some include a patio. Additionally, accommodation includes bed linen and towels. Oiti Beach Resort Tutoia serves a buffet or continental breakfast.</p>
